flags.summary: March 2026: the Marion County Election Board referred allegations that a re-election video used footage from an official visit to the State Inspector General and State Ethics Commission. His campaign called the allegations meritless. No outcome had been reported as of this review.
flags.note: Previously shown in the public profile.

sources.title: Election board refers secretary of state to inspector general over alleged misuse of state resources

flags.summary: In June 2026, Hamilton County officials flagged one petition page with suspect signatures gathered by a single volunteer, and state police opened an investigation. The campaign said it ended the volunteer's involvement. No outcome had been reported as of this review.
flags.note: Previously shown in the public profile.

sources.title: Ballard campaign disavows 'rogue' volunteer accused of forging signatures
